task.title: Preserve description structure in workbook show instead of collapsing to one line
task.description:
Deferred from PR #26 (WB-01KZBT1DRC6DYAGHWJXN9EQ9MT, sanitize control characters in text-mode output) as a minor review finding.

internal/cli/output.go:437 renders the description as singleLine(task.Description). That satisfies the ticket's acceptance criterion — a newline in a description can no longer forge a top-level 'Status: done' field line — but it does so with the most lossy option available: every multi-line description collapses into a single unwrapped line.

Measured impact: running the PR binary against this repo's own data, 'workbook show WB-01KZBT1DRC6DYAGHWJXN9EQ9MT' prints Description: as a single ~2,581-character line where it previously rendered as readable paragraphs. Most tasks in this project have multi-paragraph descriptions, so the primary human-facing read command became materially harder to read.

Proposed fix: instead of collapsing, sanitize each line with core.DisplayLine (internal/core/text.go) and emit continuation lines indented with a tab. That preserves paragraph structure while keeping the forgery protection, because real top-level writeShow fields are unindented — a forged 'Status: done' line would render as '\tStatus: done' and could not parse as a top-level field. Confirm against the parsing assumptions in TestShowKeepsMultiLineDescriptionsOnOneLine (internal/cli/sanitize_test.go), whose name and assertions would need to change.

Also update the 'Text-mode output safety' section of README.md (around lines 625-638), which currently documents the one-line rule and redirects consumers to --json without acknowledging the readability cost.

Deferred rather than fixed in PR #26 because the collapse is correct and safe as shipped; this is a presentation improvement that changes documented behavior and an existing test's contract, so it deserves its own review.
